scope: Assisted MuJoCo development regression; expanded clutter/layout conditions. Provided RGBD map and native state; no observed-only qualification or benchmark denominator. Distractor footprints touch the goal boundary on the reachable far sides. Near-side (left/front) distractors are excluded: the goal region's near edges sit close to the target's grasp pose, so a distractor there occludes the provided scan and fails the grasp before the release. Declared positions are development diagnostics, not held-out benchmark fixtures with independent replay certificates.
